notes:
Fixes backup drives dropping out while SafeStore checks the backup.

- A backup drive that disconnects while SafeStore is checking the backup no longer marks files as changed
- Plug it back in and the check and uploads carry on by themselves
- If this update won't install: download SafeStore.dmg from the beta releases page, quit SafeStore with nothing transferring, then drag the new SafeStore into Applications. Updates work by themselves after that
